verdict.rationale: OneDrive's API surface is Microsoft Graph. Graph publishes a versioning and support policy with separate v1.0 and beta endpoints, ties itself to the Microsoft Lifecycle Policy, and commits to declaring versions or GA APIs deprecated at least 24 months before retirement. The versioned URLs (graph-rest-1.0, /v1.0/$metadata) corroborate this. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the deprecation window is honored in practice, and the beta endpoint carries no such stability guarantee.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Microsoft declares a version as deprecated at least 24 months in advance of retiring it
Microsoft Graph follows the Microsoft Lifecycle Policy
You can use Microsoft Graph to create an app that connects with files across OneDrive, OneDrive for Business, and SharePoint document libraries
